description.value: Sugar Lab Pancake House is a specialty dessert cafe in Burnaby focused on Mille Crepe cakes — elegant multi-layered French-inspired crepe cakes available in a wide range of flavours from mango and durian to matcha and tiramisu. The shop offers both walk-in dine-in service and a preorder pickup model for whole cakes. The About page describes a cozy, spacious atmosphere designed for lingering over dessert with friends or family.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 70m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 76m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for sugarlabcake.ca is fully accessible and confirms this is a specialty dessert cafe (Mille Crepe cakes, pancakes) at 5376 Grimmer St, Burnaby — matching the OSM address. The phone number (604) 451-9149 appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-relevant amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the content is entirely focused on cake preorders and dine-in desserts. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Sugar Lab' while the website consistently uses 'Sugar Lab Pancake House'.
